messages:
alex: Heads-up — publish job failed for sample-sdk: semver inference flagged a minor but package.json stayed patch.
regen-bot: CI: regendiff check failed on commit 9a7d2c - modified: packages/sample-sdk/src/types.d.ts
priya: Paste the regendiff please?
alex: snippet: 
```
- export type AuthOpts = { token?: string }
+ export type AuthOpts = { token?: string }
+ export type RetryPolicy = { maxAttempts?: number }
```
dan: Hmm, RetryPolicy is type-only but leaked into public export via typegen after the retry-surface refactor. Our semver rules consider exported type adds as minor.
chloe: The changelog generator only looks at commit labels so it didn't suggest a minor bump -> mismatch.
priya: short-term: pin @redwood/typegen to 1.4.1 in sample-sdk package.json and rerun CI.
dan: I'll open the PR. Also propose adding /** @internal */ to RetryPolicy so it doesn't get exported.
alex: Could we instead update the semver inference to treat type-only additions that don't change runtime shape as patch?
chloe: That feels risky — consumers using types can still break. Let's be conservative but document the rule.
priya: For onboarding: add a checklist to run `yarn regen` and commit types before opening PRs for SDKs.
dan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-sdk/pull/501 - pins typegen, adds CI note.
regen-bot: CI started for sample-sdk/pull/501.
alex: action items: dan to land PR; chloe to draft internal type export guideline; priya to update onboarding doc; eng-devex to evaluate semver heuristics.
chloe: filed ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DX-995-typegen-semantics-guideline
priya: I'll add the regen checklist to docs/dev/onboarding.md and link the ticket.
dan: Thanks — will re-run regen after PR merges and report back. :thumbsup:
